notes.title: FIX: Performance, Crash & More fixed - Radar removed
notes.notes:
The game had major performance issues and crashed after about 20 minutes.
The problem was found in the radar feature. 
For now, players will have to find the antiviruses without the radar! ːsteamsaltyː
This feature had to be removed from the game and may be added later in updates once a fix is implemented.

I apologize for the day-one issues, and I hope you have fun playing! ːsteammockingː
